paragraphs: Rav Shimi of Nehardea. Pesahim 52b; Yoma 6a; Bava Kamma 26a; Makkot 16a; Berakhot 36b: he challenges Rava. Ha-Manniah 32b: Rava struck him with his sandal. Rav Nahman bar Yitzhak spoke in his name.
